summary: Tested the [object Object] bug fix for AI-suggested improvements. All 22 backend tests passed verifying: 1) _build_improved_elements type-checks content (dict, list, string, None), 2) _apply_ai_result_to_slides type-checks title, notes, elements, 3) Frontend type guards in SlideCanvas, CoursePreview, SplitPreview, 4) GET /api/projects/{id} sanitizes non-string htmlContent, 5) preview-improvements, apply-improvements, undo-improvements endpoints work correctly.

GOOD: SplitPreview processHtmlContent checks typeof htmlContent !== 'string'
GOOD: GET /api/projects/{id} sanitizes non-string htmlContent and auto-saves fixed data
